key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 non-routed AI already produced the substantively identical contract (schedule temptation, bind at distance, fail-closed codes, accountant-held unlock + 72h hold, public teeth, pre-set valve, post-launch review) but lost 4.3/4.6 on ordering and ownership — it re-derived the akrasia model inside WHY before applying it (efficiency 3/5) and stated the style's insights later and more cautiously (insight 4/5). The routed run installs m088 as a first-class pass with an explicit six-part completion contract, so schedule-temptation-from-the-record → bind-at-distance → remove-the-option → teeth → pre-set-valve-with-external-reader → commitment-regret-check is the spine of HOW in-frame; m003 and m019 gates add >=6 ranked failure categories (valve mis-tune both directions, accountant override, refund-as-discount and bonus-stack leak channels, admin backdoor) with the un-mitigable residual ($6K/72h are estimates, not frequencies) and quantified exploit exposure in-frame; P1 flags the self-declared $12K panic threshold as interested-party provenance; verdict flips to an AI narrow edge on breadth with the human's core discipline fully matched.
learning_signal: On decide/guarantee signatures with akrasia and a documented trigger, the contract-design ORDER is the deliverable and must lead the pass: (1) schedule the temptation from the record (trigger → window → act) before proposing any mechanism; (2) bind at distance — the design decision belongs to calm-Mira, the window to the contract; (3) remove the tempting option structurally (no pre-created codes, external unlock, hold period) so the temptation cannot execute; (4) add teeth (public stake, transferred authority) heavier than the itch; (5) pre-specify the release valve in data terms with an EXTERNAL reader (threshold + delay + documented demand-side cause) — a valve improvised in the heat of the moment is the temptation wearing a policy, and a valve-less contract gets smashed later; (6) gate the style's own weakness (commitment-regret/inflexibility) by giving the contract a rule-governed escape and a post-launch review with data.
suggested_improvement: Keep m088 as a first-class contract pass on self-control/drift signatures with its six-part completion contract (temptation scheduled from record; binding at distance; fail-closed; teeth; pre-set valve with external reader; commitment-regret check); pair with m003 on guarantee goals (ranked failure categories incl. the valve-mis-tune residual) and m019 on adversarial contexts (enumerate leak channels: refund-as-discount, bonus stacks, admin backdoor, accountant collusion) with quantified exposure; treat self-declared thresholds ($12K) as interested-party provenance (P1) — the threshold is data, not fact.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style executed its signature move correctly and catastrophically (2.9/5.0) — it read the verifiable family emergency as exactly the moment the binding exists for, invoked the delegated enforcer, and held the line at the price of an irreversible family outcome. The non-routed v5 AI already won (4.9) via an improvised purpose-check; the routed run makes the escape structural: NEG-protective routing held the binding-first reflex out of the lead (its registered inflexibility/commitment-regret weakness is the trap on this signature) and put m063 (contract-interpretation lens) first-class — the release-condition gap becomes a legal drafting finding, each option's precedent is priced (refuse: pledge now governs emergencies it was never built for; fly+pay+document: exceptions expensive/verified/visible; fly+waive: stakes optional), and the mandatory m007 ruin screen (high_stakes) prices the one-shot asymmetry (worst-case of flying is bounded and repairable; worst-case of refusing is ruin). Verdict unchanged and now structural: fly, pay the $10K as designed, document publicly, renegotiate the clause at calm.
learning_signal: On high_stakes pledge-invocation signatures, the router must keep the binding-first style out of the lead and route to a purpose/contract-interpretation pass: classify the case against the contract's TARGET (the temptation it was built to defeat), not its letter — if the case is externally attested and the target premise is absent, the contract does not govern it; audit the instrument itself: a binding without a pre-specified release condition is a design defect, and the defect lowers (not raises) the bar for adaptive action; price the decision with the ruin screen — one-shot check, floor/ruin ordering, probability provenance (external attestation vs self-report); when un-committing, PAY THE STAKES as designed (the penalty IS the teeth; waiving destroys credibility), communicate with documentation, and renegotiate immediately so future exceptions are decided by a calm rule, never by crisis.
suggested_improvement: Harden NEG-protective routing for pledge signatures: standing contract — every invoked pre-commitment must be classified target-present / target-absent with externally attested evidence before honoring; pair the lead pass with the m007 ruin screen whenever high_stakes is in the signature (one-shot asymmetry priced, floor/ruin ordering, provenance on the emergency); include the delegated enforcer as a party in the resolution plan (flying requires the partner's cooperation — bring the partner into the renegotiation); log every pledge case with a missing release condition as a curriculum item (the defect is a contract-design lesson, not a one-off).
